label: Pawn: Build
command: if (Test-Path "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawn.json") { & sampctl build } elseif ((Test-Path "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawncc.exe") -and (Test-Path "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawndisasm.exe") -and (Test-Path "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawnc.dll")) { & "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawncc.exe" "$ZED_FILE" "-D$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\gamemodes" "-i$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\include" "-o$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\gamemodes\$ZED_STEM.amx" "-;+" "-(+" "-v2" } else { Write-Error "No Pawn build tool detected."; exit 1 }

label: Pawn: Build with pawncc
command: if ((Test-Path "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawncc.exe") -and (Test-Path "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawndisasm.exe") -and (Test-Path "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawnc.dll")) { & "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\pawncc.exe" "$ZED_FILE" "-D$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\gamemodes" "-i$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\pawno\include" "-o$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT\gamemodes\$ZED_STEM.amx" "-;+" "-(+" "-v2" } else { Write-Error "Pawno compiler not found in workspace\pawno."; exit 1 }
